feeds.title: WBA Boxing » WBA Female
feeds.description: Read news, stories, and articles about Women's Boxing in this section of the World Boxing Association. World Boxing Association (WBA) was formed in 1921, in Rhode Island, originally called as National Boxing Association, it controls this professional activity, with limited jurisdiction in the United States.

feeds.title: Austin Women's Boxing Club Blog
feeds.description: Our blog seeks to give advice and tools to ladies who want to start boxing. We are the only all-female boxing gym in Austin, and all of our managers and coaches are certified by USA Boxing. We offer our coaching services to both newcomers and competitors who are willing to compete at a local club level.

feeds.title: Punch Love Blog
feeds.description: Our wide range of services provided includes women's only boxing fitness, strength & conditioning programs, and a detailed nutrition plan. Punch Love women's fitness is a premium, women's only gym focused on boxing & conditioning fitness.

feeds.description: Ring 24 aims to provide exclusive coverage of the latest happenings in the women's boxing world. Ringnews24 writes about professional boxing and reports about daily boxing news and results from around the world.
